summary: Full backend + frontend validation for the 4 new features: (a) server.py modularization via routes_database_ext.py, (b) full-page Add/Edit Roles & Offices, (c) Audit Log CSV/Excel export + purge, (d) Backup settings (S3 config, schedule, retention, delete backup). 15/15 new backend pytest cases pass; all frontend flows verified.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_database_ext.py cleanly extracts backup/S3/retention/scheduler concerns from server.py, but server.py is still ~3847 lines. Continue splitting audit, offices, roles, branding, broadcast into their own routers.

test_s3 endpoint returns 200 with {ok:false,...} even for auth/network errors. That's the intended graceful contract, but consider returning distinct hints (missing creds vs. auth failure vs. bucket missing) so the UI can render specific feedback.
AUDIT_EXPORT_CAP (50000) is a hard cap without pagination in the export. For large tenants document this limit in the UI or add multi-file/streamed CSV.
_scheduler_loop polls every 60s and interprets schedule_time in UTC. The UI does not clearly disclose that. Either display 'UTC' next to the time input or convert to server tz.
perform_backup writes the full JSON payload to memory (json.dumps then encode). For very large DBs this is O(N) memory; acceptable for CMS scale but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ROLE_<ts> and TO<num> office rows during UI test; a few backups were created & pruned by retention tests. No destructive replace-restore was executed. Backup schedule left disabled and retention restored to 7.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression at /app/backend/tests/test_backup_settings_audit_export.py covers backup settings GET/PUT with defaults, secret write-only semantics, invalid schedule_interval → 400, S3 test with no creds → {ok:false}, POST /database/backup includes s3_key field, list_backups includes s3_key, retention enforcement, DELETE backup 200/404 and audit-log 'backup' & 'purge' entries, and audit-logs/export CSV & XLSX content-types + q-filter. Frontend verified: /database toggles for schedule/S3 reveal fields, retention save persists across reload, backup History has delete-with-confirm; /audit-log Export dropdown offers CSV & Excel (download works), Purge dialog exposes From/To + destructive confirm; /roles Add navigates to /roles/new (full-page role-form-page), save returns to /roles; row-actions dropdown → Edit navigates to /roles/{id}/edit with prefilled name and save persists; /offices Add navigates to /offices/new, save returns to /offices; breadcrumbs 'Manage › Roles › Add Role' and 'Manage › Offices › Add Office' render correctly.
